key.name: toggle-recording-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to toggle speech recording
key.description: The keyboard shortcut used to start and stop speech recording

key.name: cancel-recording-shortcut
key.description: Additional key to stop recording immediately (Escape by default)

key.name: whisper-model
key.summary: Whisper model to use for transcription
key.description: The Whisper model size to use. Larger models are more accurate but slower.

key.name: whisper-language
key.description: Language code for Whisper transcription (auto for automatic detection)

key.name: audio-sample-rate
key.description: Sample rate for audio recording. 16000 Hz is optimal for Whisper.

key.name: audio-format
key.description: Audio format to use for recording

key.name: audio-channels
key.description: Number of audio channels (1=mono, 2=stereo). Mono is recommended for speech.

key.name: max-recording-duration
key.description: Maximum time to record audio before automatically stopping

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Whether to show notification messages for transcription results and errors

key.name: sounds-enabled
key.description: When enabled, the extension will play a short ding sound on certain actions (e.g., shortcut press).

key.name: whisper-executable
key.description: Path to the whisper.cpp command line tool (installed in ~/apps/whisper.cpp/build/bin/whisper-cli)

key.name: audio-recorder
key.description: Audio recording tool to use (arecord for ALSA, parecord for PulseAudio)

key.name: type-as-i-speak-enabled
key.description: Type transcriptions into the focused application while you speak.

key.name: type-as-i-speak-interval-ms
key.summary: Type As I Speak interval in milliseconds
key.description: How often to process incremental transcription while recording. Lower is more responsive but uses more CPU. Recommended 400–1200ms.

key.name: type-as-i-speak-stream-enabled
key.description: Use whisper.cpp's microphone streaming binary instead of the reliable file-backed live transcription mode.

key.name: stream-min-chunk
key.description: Minimum number of characters to accumulate before inserting live (unless a clear boundary like space or punctuation is reached).

key.name: stream-flush-delay
key.description: Debounce time in milliseconds for partial results before inserting live text.

key.name: stream-max-chunk
key.description: Upper limit on the number of characters inserted in one operation to prevent target app jank.

key.name: stream-stabilize-ms
key.description: Additional delay window before flushing if the partial text doesn’t end with whitespace/punctuation. Helps avoid backtracking artifacts.

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: When enabled, the extension may write diagnostic artifacts like logs and audio test files to the Desktop. Keep disabled for normal use.
